entry_lifecycle.catalyst_logic: The catalyst is the close-only 20-session range break in USDNOK together with the other krone and krona breaks. A daily close back inside those ranges ends it.
entry_lifecycle.realization_logic: Hold the long to the five-session mark from the Nov 20 breakout, and leave earlier if a daily close puts USDNOK back inside the broken range.

entry_rationale: Long USDNOK on the shared Nov 20 breakout in the krone and krona. Dollar-bloc signals disagree or have already failed.
entry_thesis: Buy USDNOK in 10 million on a five-session horizon. The Nov 20 close at 9.753 is a breakout up, and the same fixing broke up in EURNOK, GBPNOK, CHFNOK, and USDSEK, so the offer is in the krone and the krona together. AUDUSD and AUDJPY disagree, NZDUSD has failed back inside its range, and AUDCAD is only sitting on its 20-day low.

events.rationale: Long USDNOK on the shared Nov 20 breakout in the krone and krona. Dollar-bloc signals disagree or have already failed.

invalidation: The long dies if USDNOK records a daily close back inside the 20-session range broken at 9.753, or if EURNOK, GBPNOK, CHFNOK, or USDSEK close back inside their ranges and remove the cross-sectional break.
